name: Muha Meds x 5pk Infused Prerolls | Strawberry Dream
description: Savor the sweet and soothing experience of Strawberry Dream Mates. Each puff brings forth the delectable essence of ripe strawberries, enveloping you in a blanket of relaxation. Perfect for unwinding after a long day, these pre-rolls offer a mellow and euphoric high that melts away stress and promotes tranquility. Indulge in the fruity goodness of Strawberry Dream Mates for a flavorful escape into bliss.
